parsed.explanation: The dossier documents no traveler-facing exposure: no criminalisation (2016 repeal), no facility, custody, border or care restriction, no police targeting or violence record, and a 2024 hate-crime statute expressly covering gender identity with enhanced sentences — a genuine, current, visitor-reachable protection, plus constitutional non-discrimination and torture guarantees. Nothing here is tier 1–3. What holds it back: no documented social acceptance of gender diversity (unlike the acceptance tiers), the protections are recent and untested in enforcement (paper protections, tier 5), and the dossier explicitly leaves police practice, entry screening, document markers, facilities and care undocumented — open questions, not proven harms. A travel guide's 'stay vigilant' note is unspecific. Applying rule 13, this sits a step below the acceptance-plus-working-protections tier, with no documented negative to subtract further.
